title: Emergency Fund Calculator
description: Set 3, 6 and 9 month emergency fund targets from your expenses and plan how fast you can get there.
howto: Add your current emergency savings and monthly contribution.
Read your 3/6/9-month targets and months until each is funded.

faqs.q: How big should my emergency fund be?
faqs.a: 3-6 months of essential expenses is the standard guidance; 9-12 months suits freelancers or single-income households.
Somewhere safe and liquid but slightly out of reach: a high-yield savings account, not invested in stocks.
Housing, food, transport, insurance, utilities and minimum debt payments — the bills that continue if income stops.
